name: Zernike Subtraction
definition: A method to directly optimize spot quality at each farfield target point by iteratively subtracting aberration, applicable to non-imaging-based indirect feedback metrics.
summary: Zernike Subtraction iteratively optimizes spot quality by subtracting measured aberrations, distinguishing itself from the Gerchberg-Saxton Algorithm through local, aberration-space corrections derived from sweeping global Zernike modes.
